title: barkworthia stillmanii
intro: Barkworthia stillmanii, commonly known as the "Tobacco Plant," is a plant species in the family Icacinaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an antispasmodic and an antitussive, providing relief from spasms and coughs. Bioactive constituents of Barkworthia stillmanii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
